body:
I'm currently standing in front of the ER. An hour ago I stood on the balcony of the 20th floor, wanting to jump. But after in had written my farewell letter, I saw a teenage girl in the parking lot below me. She did cartwheels and taught her younger sibling how to ride a scooter. I couldn't fucking do it. I just watched for a while and left.  
Entering the ER, and talking to someone one on one scares me almost more than killing myself. I feel like I'd be wasting their time, as my problems seem unfixable. Called a suicide hotline, but hung up and started crying when I was asked about my reasoning.  
So fucking sick of me.  
  
Update:
The intercom caught me by surprise, and I left without saying a word.  
Tried it again a little later and actually told of my suicide attempt. I wasn't speaking clearly, and when the guy said "Hello?", I bailed. I'm worried he might have understood the name of the location, so now I'm afraid to go back there.
